segments.he: הַשּׁוֹחֵט חַיָּה וָעוֹף בְּיוֹם טוֹב וְכוּ׳.
segments.en: § The mishna states that Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel also dispute whether or not «one who slaughters an undomesticated animal or a bird on a Festival,» without having prepared earth the day before with which to cover the blood after the slaughter, may dig out earth on the Festival itself to cover the blood.

moves.summary: The Gemara quotes the mishna's clause on slaughtering on a Festival.
moves.about: quotes the mishna on slaughtering a wild animal or bird on a Festival
